descriptionHtml:
122 × 91cm. 18cm of layered foam. Room to lie right out.

Bowfell is an XXL orthopaedic chaise dog bed, 122 × 91 × 18cm, with layered foam and an egg-crate upper profile. An L-shaped bolster runs along two sides and the other two are left completely open.

If you own a giant dog you already know what most large beds look like underneath them. Front end on the cushion, back legs on the floor. They shuffle forward through the night, and by morning half of them is asleep on the laminate.

At 122 × 91cm there is a full body length to work with, and 18cm of foam under the hips means a heavy dog is not resting on your boards through a bit of fabric.

What they get

  • 122 × 91 × 18cm: Room for a large or giant breed to lie full length.
  • An L-shaped bolster: Cover down two sides and a corner to rest a head in.
  • Two sides left completely open: No wall eating the footprint and nothing to step over.
  • Layered foam with an egg-crate top: Built to carry a heavy dog without compressing flat.

Best for: giant breeds who sleep flat out, dogs who overhang every large bed you have tried, and rooms with floor to spare.

Why it is worth the money

£155 is a lot for a dog bed, so here is where it goes. On a bed this size a full surround can swallow a third of what you paid. Keeping two sides open means the footprint you buy is close to the footprint they use. The rest sits in the foam: a layered core with an egg-crate profile on top.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

This is a great deal of bed. At 122 × 91cm it will not tuck in beside an armchair, and the open edges want clear floor. There is no waterproof lining in this one, so a household with regular accidents wants one of the sofa beds instead.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Shape
XXL, one size122 × 91 × 18L-shaped bolster on two sides, two sides open to the edge

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that along two edges. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Esthwaite is the same L-shape at 112 × 84 × 15cm. Bowfell is the one to take when your dog is giant rather than large.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Air-dry it fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Will a giant dog actually fit on it?

The outside is 122 × 91cm with two sides usable right to the edge. If your measurement lands close, message us first.

Why only two bolstered sides?

Big dogs and fully enclosed beds rarely work. There is not enough room inside the walls, and a dog that size does not want boxing in.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Give a giant dog 122 × 91cm and two open sides.
